_comment: Round-259 multi-locale fixtures for digital.vasic.optimization. Used by challenges/scripts/optimization_describe_challenge.sh and challenges/runner/main.go to verify UTF-8 / non-ASCII text round-trips losslessly through gptcache.InMemoryCache (Set/Get + semantic match), prompt.Template.Render (rune-safe {{Name}} substitution), prompt.Compressor.Optimize (whitespace + filler-phrase + truncation), streaming.StreamBuffer (FlushOnSentence + FlushOnWord), streaming.TokenCounter / ChunkMerger, and outlines.SchemaBuilder / JSONConstrainer (rune-aware extraction + min/max length). CONST-046 alignment: no hardcoded English-only assumption.
